summary: Jaguar Health, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Nasdaq Hearings Panel decision granting an extension to May 18, 2026, to regain compliance with the $1.00 bid price rule after exercising pre-funded warrants on May 4, 2026, cured the public float deficiency. The filing describes a listing-compliance procedural update with no M&A, activist campaign, tender offer, or other special-situation event. No deal terms are present. This is a routine current report on a regulatory compliance matter.
